qe: Choose the correct completion: “Hardly had the train left ___ the passengers reached the platform.”
qh: सही शब्द चुनिए: “Hardly had the train left ___ the passengers reached the platform.”
e: The standard correlative construction is “hardly … when.”

qe: Which sentence correctly expresses a third conditional?
qh: कौन-सा वाक्य third conditional को सही रूप में व्यक्त करता है?
o: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.
oh: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.
e: A third conditional uses past perfect in the if-clause and “would have” + past participle in the result clause.
eh: Third conditional में if-clause में past perfect और परिणाम वाले उपवाक्य में “would have” + past participle आता है।
oe: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I will help.
If I know, I would helped.
If I had know, I helped.
If I would know, I had helped.

qe: Choose the correct agreement: “Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable.”
qh: सही क्रिया-रूप चुनिए: “Neither of the two proposals ___ acceptable.”
e: “Neither” is singular in formal standard usage, so it takes “is.”
eh: मानक औपचारिक प्रयोग में “Neither” एकवचन है, इसलिए इसके साथ “is” आता है।

qe: What is the function of the underlined clause in “I know where she lives”?
qh: “I know where she lives” में “where she lives” उपवाक्य का कार्य क्या है?
o: Noun clause functioning as the object of “know”
oh: “know” के कर्म के रूप में प्रयुक्त संज्ञा उपवाक्य
“I” की विशेषता बताने वाला विशेषण उपवाक्य
e: “Where she lives” answers “what do I know?” and functions as the object of “know,” so it is a noun clause.
eh: “Where she lives” प्रश्न “मैं क्या जानता हूँ?” का उत्तर देता है और “know” का कर्म है; इसलिए यह संज्ञा उपवाक्य है।
oe: Noun clause functioning as the object of “know”

qe: Which figure of speech is used in “The classroom was a zoo after the bell”?
qh: “The classroom was a zoo after the bell” में कौन-सा figure of speech है?
e: The classroom is directly described as a zoo without “like” or “as,” making it a metaphor.
eh: कक्षा को “like” या “as” के बिना सीधे चिड़ियाघर कहा गया है, इसलिए यह रूपक है।

qe: Choose the correct sentence using a gerund after a preposition.
qh: preposition के बाद gerund का सही प्रयोग वाला वाक्य चुनिए।
o: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.
oh: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.
e: A verb following the preposition “in” takes the -ing form: “in learning.”
eh: “In” preposition के बाद आने वाली क्रिया -ing रूप में होती है: “in learning।”
oe: She is interested in learning Sanskrit.
She is interested in learn Sanskrit.
She is interested to learning Sanskrit.
She is interested for learn Sanskrit.

qe: Which word is the antonym of “transient”?
e: “Transient” means temporary or short-lived; “permanent” is its opposite.
eh: “Transient” का अर्थ अस्थायी या अल्पकालिक है; इसका विलोम “permanent” है।

qe: Choose the correctly punctuated direct speech.
qh: प्रत्यक्ष कथन में सही विराम-चिह्न वाला विकल्प चुनिए।
o: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.
oh: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.
e: A reporting clause is followed by a comma, and the quoted sentence begins and ends with quotation marks; the full stop belongs inside the closing quotation mark in this style.
eh: कथन से पहले comma आता है और उद्धृत वाक्य quotation marks में रखा जाता है; इस शैली में पूर्ण विराम अंतिम उद्धरण-चिह्न के भीतर आता है।
oe: Ravi said, I will return tomorrow.

qe: In “The committee has published its report,” why is “has” acceptable?
qh: “The committee has published its report” में “has” क्यों सही है?
o: The collective noun is treated as a single body
The tense requires a plural verb
oh: समूहवाचक संज्ञा को एक इकाई माना गया है
e: When a collective noun is viewed as one unit, singular agreement is standard; the pronoun “its” reinforces that reading.
eh: जब समूहवाचक संज्ञा को एक इकाई माना जाता है, तो एकवचन क्रिया मानक है; “its” भी इसी अर्थ की पुष्टि करता है।
oe: The collective noun is treated as a single body
The tense requires a plural verb

qe: Read: “The village library opened at dawn. Before school, children borrowed storybooks and returned them the next day.” What habit does the passage describe?
qh: पढ़िए: “The village library opened at dawn. Before school, children borrowed storybooks and returned them the next day.” अनुच्छेद किस आदत का वर्णन करता है?
o: Regular borrowing and returning of books
oh: किताबें नियमित रूप से लेना और लौटाना
विद्यालय से पहले पुस्तकालय बंद करना
e: The children borrow books before school and return them the next day, showing a regular library-use habit.
eh: बच्चे विद्यालय से पहले किताबें लेते हैं और अगले दिन लौटाते हैं; यह पुस्तकालय के नियमित उपयोग की आदत है।
oe: Regular borrowing and returning of books
